info.description:
Fireblocks provides a suite of applications to manage digital asset operations and a complete development platform to build your business on the blockchain.

item.name: Set an AML customer reference ID for an external wallet

header.description: A unique identifier for the request. If the request is sent multiple times with the same idempotency key, the server will return the same response as the first request. The idempotency key is valid for 24 hours.

request.description:
Sets an AML/KYT customer reference ID for the specific external wallet.

External Wallet is a whitelisted address of a wallet that belongs to your users/counterparties.

- You cannot see the balance of the external wallet.
- You cannot initiate transactions from an external wallet as the source via Fireblocks.
Learn more about Whitelisted External Wallet Addresses [here](https://developers.fireblocks.com/docs/whitelist-addresses#external-wallets).
</br>Endpoint Permission: Admin, Non-Signing Admin, Signer, Approver, Editor.
